t: The Magnusson Base 700 is a versatile LED work light designed for clear illumination. This robust torch is ideal for mechanics, plumbers and maintenance engineers working in dark garages or under sinks. It delivers a powerful output of up to 700 lumens across 3 x lighting modes to suit various tasks. A durable plastic body provides impact resistance up to 1m, whilst the integrated magnet and hook enable hands-free operation. Supplied with a USB-C charging dock, the unit remains powered and ready for daily professional use.
b: With Magnet & Hook for Hands-Free Working
